title: Sharing
record_notice: The owner sees when you open a shared finding.
with_me_empty: Nobody has shared a finding with you.
waiting_send: It opens when their computer sends it.
other_device: This was shared before this computer joined. It opens when the owner opens Anagram again.
withdrawn: {sender} stopped sharing this. The copy that you opened before stays on this computer.
fact_waiting: they get it when they open Anagram on a device
fact_lab: each lab member can read it
public: This finding is public. That cannot be changed.
share_placeholder: Name, email address, or ORCID iD
share_record: They get this version and the next versions. Anagram tells you when they open it.
share_invite: A person who is not a member gets an invite. Only that person can use it: they prove their email address or ORCID iD first.
third_title: This finding has other people's words
third_text: These files quote other people, for example in an email:
third_ask: Make sure that you may share their words before you continue.
links_text: Anagram has no email address for an ORCID iD. Send this link to the person. It works only for them.
stop_text: From now on {name} cannot open this finding in Anagram, and does not get the next versions.
stop_kept: Anagram cannot take back what {name} opened or saved before now.

stop_reads.one: {name} opened this finding one time, on {date}.
stop_reads.other: {name} opened this finding {n} times, last on {date}.

stop_lab_title: Take this finding out of the lab space?
stop_lab_text: From now on lab members cannot open it in the lab space. Anagram cannot take back what they saved before now.
stop_invite_text: The invite link stops working, and {name} cannot open this finding.

rekey_text.one: You can also make a new version with a new key for the one person who keeps access. Anagram then removes the old encrypted copy from the community server.
rekey_text.other: You can also make a new version with a new key for the {n} people who keep access. Anagram then removes the old encrypted copy from the community server.

rekey_none: You can also make a new version with a new key. Anagram then removes the old encrypted copy from the community server.
person_empty: You have not shared a finding with this person.
about_opened: A read record shows that the app of the reader opened the finding. It does not show that a person read it.
about_copy: A reader can copy what they read and show it to another person. No record shows that.
about_changed: A changed app must sign a read record to get the finding. After that, it can read its copy with no more records.
about_node: The community server can refuse to send the finding, or hide later records from you. It cannot make a read record for a reader.
about_public: A public finding has no read record.
rings_lead: Rings go from your closest people outward. When you share with a ring, the rings inside it get the finding too.
ring_collaborators: People outside your lab that you work with.
ring_public: Everyone. Sharing here publishes the finding. You cannot take this back.
choose_person: Choose a person from the search results.
claim_text: {name} ({email}) joined with your invite to {contact}. Give this person the finding?
